note: Talent categories of which only one applies to one use (docket 2026-09-28; owner 2026-09-27: "some of the logic points toward only one"). A talent's category is the tag printed in its heading ("### Draw Past - Response"). combat/factory_compiler.py: an ability's modifiers from a one-per category are choices (one variant each) instead of all at once. Area categories (Darkness, Dreamscape, Fragrance, Ashfall, Conflagration) are the areas' shapes; the Dark sphere's Meld is combat/senses.py.
